description:
Returns the starting weights of the eight scoring categories in the HireGPS model for one seniority level, or for all seven levels, as published on hiregps.app.
Example input: {"seniority": "Senior"}

seniority.description: Optional seniority level: Entry, Junior, Mid-Level, Senior, Manager, Director or Executive. Leave empty for all seven.
seniority.title: Seniority
